programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

Unless, of course, they land on a "Whammy," which takes away the player's loot. The contestant with the most accumulated cash and prizes at the end of the show is the winner.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Sharyn Alfonsi, Anderson Cooper, Steve Kroft, Lara Logan, Norah O'Donnell, Scott Pelley, Charlie Rose, Lesley Stahl, Jon Wertheim, Oprah Winfrey and Bill Whitaker.

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

In a ploy to keep everyone together, Wilton lies about his wealth and announces he's financially ruined. After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr. Steele, but more troubling medical news may sabotage her new relationship, and her second chance at life.

When Gehrig marries his spirited sweetheart, Eleanor (Teresa Wright), things look up for him, but he is soon sidelined by a terrible illness that he bravely tries to battle.

Once he recovers, he and Aimee wed, and he returns to baseball and begins an increasingly successful career -- until he's diagnosed with epilepsy, which he struggles to hide from the public and Aimee.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: In Memphis, a shooting leads to a stand-off and dispute among friends.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: Two patrol officers driving on a service road notice a dark shape at the curb.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right….

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson stars as a radio station owner who builds a three-dimensional television receiver which accidentally intercepts a "galaxy being" whose strange form and deadly radiation triggers a tide of panic and violence!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: The Hundred Days Of The Dragon
programme.desc: In a terrifyingly timely story of genetic engineering and political power plays, Sidney Blackmer stars as a popular American President who puts into place a master plan to slowly and steadily destroy the United States. James Hong also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In order to unifying the nations of Earth, a group of scientists sets out to secretly create the ultimate, global threat -- an all-powerful alien monster -- via human mutation! Robert Culp stars as the scientist chosen to undergo the transformation.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A meek, unassuming college professor (Donald Pleasence) invents a device capable of controlling the entire electro-magnetic spectrum and realizes the device has unleashed his subconscious thirst for revenge—with uncontrollable and deadly results!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: The Man Who Was Never Born
programme.desc: Martin Landau stars as the time-traveler Andro who is desperately trying to stop the birth of a crazed 20th century inventor whose bacterium invention turns humans into hideous mutants. Shirley Knight co-stars in this classic, touching episode.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Both a cautionary tale and a tight courtroom drama, this haunting episode explores the fear and hostility that result when all privacy is eliminated...and all secrets are revealed! Jeff Corey, Peter Breck and Alan Baxter star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In an isolated, snowbound outpost where a handful of people are on alert against enemy attack, a crazed Army major (Harry Guardino) is haunted by the ghost of a soldier he left to die. Sally Kellerman co-stars in one of her earliest TV appearances.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Two rock samples in Dr. Temple's (Barry Atwater) lab conceal protoplasmic alien invaders capable of controlling a human "corpus." Enter Paul Cameron (Robert Culp)...who can telepathically hear the "rocks" plotting their take-over of the world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A six-man strike force is captured on the planet Ebon and brutally interrogated. And when they are suddenly allowed the "respect due a conquered enemy," the prisoners to conclude that there is a traitor among them...someone who must be killed!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: It Crawled Out Of The Woodwork
programme.desc: Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Film great Miriam Hopkins (1932's "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) returns to the screen to give a show-stopping performance as an overly ripe flapper who will stop at nothing to complete her long overdue wedding night scenario. John Hoyt also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In one of the series' most unnerving episodes, Don Gordon portrays a secret government agent who infiltrates the ranks of the Invisibles -- a subversive, underground society of the nation's power brokers who are possessed by alien parasites.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Martin Landau and Sally Kellerman star as an inventor and his ambitious wife in a parable about aspiration's devolution into greed when a failed experiment leads to the interception of a powerful alien being from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When four brilliant young men born and raised in Spider County suddenly vanish and a fifth is accused of a murder he didn't commit, the boy receives a unique invitation from an alien being who is willing to take him to a home very, very far away.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Ruth Roman, Alex Nicol and Tim O'Connor star in this compelling study of allegiance and sacrifice as a group of lunar astronauts discover a strange space vessel full of fugitives from another world…and they have a desperate story to tell.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Sent to investigate a strange situation on a possibly habitable planet, Dr. Evan Marshall (Larry Pennell) discovers the scientific team sent there is now dominated by a human mutant (Warren Oates) who can exist without sleep and kill by touch!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A drifter wanders into an eerie mansion and finds himself ill-at-ease amongst the eccentric cast of occupants, all of whom may just be part of some strange scientific study…from the dark recesses of the Outer Limits. Gloria Grahame stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: The politics of indoctrination are disturbingly portrayed -- and the Outer Limits is brought closer to home -- as a couple (Macdonald Carey, Marion Ross) welcome their son's new tutor into their home…a tutor whose motives may just be alien invasion!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: Production And Decay Of Strange Particles
programme.desc: An emergency at a nuclear power plant sets the wheels of man's possible destruction into horrifying motion as radiation gone wild tears open a dimensional hole in the reactor! George MacReady stars as the scientist who struggles to find a solution!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Robert Duvall stars as a CIA agent sent on a mission to infiltrate a downed space craft and kill the creatures inside. Mutated to appear as they do, he soon learns that the shape in which a man finds his own humanity is not always a human one.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Vera Miles and Barbara Rush stars as two women who kill a ruthless blackmailer. Fleeing from their crime, they stumble across an eccentric inventor (David McCallum) obsessed with returning the dead to life….including the man the women murdered.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In Harlan Ellison's first ever science fiction teleplay, Michael Ansara portrays a man born and bred to be a killing machine who finds himself without a war when a time warp sends him from a future earth to the present day. Lloyd Nolan also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Star Trek's William Shatner stars as the first man to successfully land on Venus. But when he suddenly starts craving heat -- more heat than humans can stand -- it is just the beginning of a nightmare brought back from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a rescue mission is sent to Mars to discover the fate of a doomed expedition, the Commander (Adam West) and his crew find themselves hunted by an invisible enemy who seems intent on picking them off...one at a time. Ted Knight co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A frustrated scientist (Warren Stevens) receives an offer he cannot refuse when an alien creature (Robert Webber) offers to provide him with the answers he seeks. In return, the scientist must hand over all of his human emotions...including love.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a highly dangerous and illegal alien creature escapes from scientist Henderson James' lab, he clones himself to kill the beast. But if the clone is not destroyed before James' memories set in, James may find his cozy life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a long-duration spaceflight simulation is invaded by an alien presence, the six astronauts inside begin turning on one another as the being preys on each of their darkest fears! Or is this all just part of the simulation...a test?

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A robot probe destined for Mars is in jeopardy when the disembodied brain meant to control it discovers that it now has the ability to control...or to destroy. Grant Williams, Elizabeth Perry, Anthony Eisley, Douglas Kennedy and Peter Hansen star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A downed fighter pilot (Dewey Martin) and his wife (Mary Murphy) find themselves stuck in a different dimension where time is frozen whilst life in the real world travels on...towards a tragedy they want desperately to avert.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a cargo plane carrying five passengers is downed in the eye of a hurricane, the passengers find themselves trapped in an eerily cavernous chamber and dependent upon the "human" compassion of their alien captors for survival. Mark Richman stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered.

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventures

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Llega el momento de la verdad cuando Goku se enfrenta a Vegeta con el destino de la Tierra en juego. Decidido a ponerse a la altura de su rival, Goku rompe la promesa que le hizo a Kaioh y arriesga la vida con el Kaioh Ken x 3.
programme.sub-title: ¡Batalla ardiente sin límites! Gokū contra Vegeta

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Al comprobar que Kakarotto es más fuerte de lo que esperaba, Vegeta decide liberar el poder destructivo definitivo de los saiyans. Por su parte, Goku comprende que la última esperanza es la técnica final de Kaioh, el Genkidama.
programme.sub-title: ¡Ahora Gokū! La técnica final de la que depende todo.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta se convierte en mono gigante y aplasta a Goku antes de que pueda reunir la energía necesaria para lanzar el Genkidama. Al mismo tiempo, Gohan siente el peligro que corre su padre y convence a Klilyn para que regresen.
programme.sub-title: ¡Fuerza de combate x 10! La gran transformación de Vegeta.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Con Vegeta Ohzaru a punto de reducir a trizas el cuerpo de Goku y, de paso, el futuro de la humanidad, la última esperanza es un plan desesperado de Klilyn, Gohan y Yajirobee para cortar la cola del terrible príncipe de los saiyans.
programme.sub-title: ¡No mueras, papá! Este es el poder latente de Gohan.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Con Goku fuera de combate, ahora todo depende de Klilyn y Gohan. Mientras Gohan trata de ganar tiempo contra el debilitado Vegeta, Klilyn espera el momento oportuno para lanzar el Genkidama de Goku contra el saiyan.
programme.sub-title: ¡Ataca, Krilin! La Genkidama repleta de esperanza.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Por increíble que parezca, Vegeta ha sobrevivido al Genkidama y se dispone a realizar un último esfuerzo para destruir la Tierra. Por suerte, justo entonces la cola de Gohan vuelve a crecer y se convierte en un Ohzaru fuera de control.
programme.sub-title: ¡Haz un milagro! Son Gohan, el Super Saiyajin.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El Duende Tortuga, Bulma y los otros llegan al lugar de la batalla para recoger a sus camaradas caídos y descubren que las bolas de dragón ya no existen. Sin embargo, Klilyn tiene un plan que podría permitir resucitar a sus amigos...
programme.sub-title: ¡Volamos hacia el espacio! El planeta de la esperanza es el hogar de Piccolo..

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Las esperanzas de llegar a Namek se pierden tras un desafortunado incidente con la cápsula de Nappa. Al menos hasta que el Sr. Popo revela a Bulma y sus amigos el paradero de la nave espacial con la que Dios llegó a la Tierra.
programme.sub-title: ¡El misterio de Yunzabit! La búsqueda de la nave espacial de Dio

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras se ultiman los preparativos, Bulma y sus amigos deben decidir quiénes viajarán hasta el lejano Namek. Finalmente los elegidos son Bulma, Klilyn y Gohan, que antes deberá convencer a su sobreprotectora madre.
programme.sub-title: ¡Despegue hacia Namekusei! El terror que espera a Gohan y a sus amigos.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: En su viaje a través del espacio, Bulma, Klilyn y Gohan tratan de ayudar a una gigantesca colonia espacial de niños. Pero antes tendrán que convencerles de que no trabajan para Freeza, el malvado tirano que destruyó su planeta natal.
programme.sub-title: ¿Amigos o enemigos? El misterio de los niños de la nave espacial gigante.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: as convencer a sus captores de que no tienen nada que ver con Freeza, Bulma y sus amigos continúan su viaje hacia Namek. Mientras, Vegeta encuentra refugio en una base militar de Freeza y comienza su recuperación.
programme.sub-title: ¿De verdad que es verdad? Ése es el planeta de la esperanza, Namek

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Parece que nuestros astronautas han tenido suerte. Dos namekianos les han atendido amablemente, ¡hasta les quieren ayudar a encontrar las bolas de dragón! No hay tiempo que perder y comienza la búsqueda
programme.sub-title: Los alienígenas amables. La bola de cinco estrellas aparece de repente

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La búsqueda de las Bolas de Dragón va viento en popa hasta que Bulma, Krilín y Son Gohan caen en una inesperada trampa
programme.sub-title: Planeta Freeza número 79. ¡La recuperación de Vegeta!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los tres viajeros han sido víctimas de un engaño, ¡dos extraterrestres les han tomado el pelo! Gohan y Krilín tendrán que reunir todo su ingenio para engañar a los villanos y marcharse del inhóspito planeta.
programme.sub-title: ¡Aquí están todas las bolas de dragón! Piccolo volverá a la vida

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Esta vez nuestros amigos llegan sanos y salvos al auténtico Namek, el planeta en que esperan encontrar las Bolas de Dragón para resucitar al Todopoderoso y tener de nuevo Bolas de Dragón en la Tierra
programme.sub-title: ¡Un nuevo enemigo terrorífico! El tirano espacial Freeza

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freezer ha detectado a Krilín y Gohan y envía a sus guerreros a eliminarles. También conoce la fuerza que tiene ahora Vegeta... Nuestros amigos tienen que esconderse ahora de su antiguo enemigo y también del tirano.
programme.sub-title: ¡La ambición de Vegeta! Yo soy el guerrero más poderoso del Universo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Gracias al maestro de la Torre Sagrada, Goku se libra del hospital con una sola alubia mágica. El padre de Bulma ha estado trabajando en una nueva nave que llevará a Goku a Namek
programme.sub-title: ¡Gokū al máximo de poder! 6 días hasta el otro extremo de la Galaxia.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Aunque los namekianos son poderosos, se enfrentan nada menos que a la elite de Freezer.Los habitantes de Namek no tienen suficiente fuerza para derrotarles, pero también cuentan con buenos luchadores.
programme.sub-title: ¡Ataque por sorpresa! El objetivo del anciano son los scouters

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Ante los despiadados métodos de este líder sin alma, Gohan no aguanta más y decide luchar
programme.sub-title: ¡Gohan en peligro! La persecución del mortífero Dodoria

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku entrena sin descanso en la nave que le llevará hacia Namek. Como es un astronauta inexperto, la reparación de la nave se convierte en una auténtica aventura, pero eso le permite aumentar su fuerza.
programme.sub-title: ¡Dodoria explota! La temible onda de choque de Vegeta

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta desata el terror en el poblado y se enfrenta a todos los guerreros que le presentan batalla.
programme.sub-title: ¡Huida del planeta en llamas! Un desesperado Kamehameha.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras Goku se entrena en la nave, Kaito se comunica con él y le da una sorpresa increíble. ¡Todos sus amigos están con el maestro! Los espíritus de Yamcha, Chaos, Ten Shin Han y Piccolo están con él.
programme.sub-title: ¡Coraje x 100! Los guerreros se reúnen con Kaio!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta se encuentra con Zarbon y lecuenta sus planes: ser inmortal y destruir al tirano. Zarbon es el tercer guerrero de la guardia personal de Freezer y no se libra del enfrentamiento contra el guerrero del espacio, que le demuestra sus progresos.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Zarbon pilla a Vegeta por sorpresa porque no espera que el soldado de elite sea capaz de nada mejor. ¡El soldado se transforma en un horrible monstruo ante los asombrados ojos del saiyano
programme.sub-title: ¡Escalofrío! La diabólica transformación del apuesto guerrero Zaabon

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín y Denda llegan hasta la residencia del Jefe Supremo sanos y salvos. El padre de todos los habitantes del planeta es un anciano con un gran poder que, además de darle una bola de dragón a Krilín, le despierta el poder que dormía en su interior.
programme.sub-title: ¡Defended el planeta de la esperanza¡. El sorprendente aumento de poder de Klilin

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freezer ordena a Zarbon que recoja el cuerpo de Vegeta que ha quedado en un estado crítico después de su lucha contra la versión transformada del soldado del tirano. Sorprendentemente, las órdenes de Freezer son curarle, a riesgo de la vida de Zarbon
programme.sub-title: Resurrección a las puertas de la muerte. El hombre milagroso, Vegeta

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín llega junto a Bulma con la bola de dragón que le ha regalado el Jefe Supremo de los nameks. Pero no se ha dado cuenta que no ha logrado despistar a Vegeta. El saiyano ha descubierto su escondite y también la bola de dragón que tiene.
programme.sub-title: ¡Una fuerza de combate inmensa! Los planes de Freeza se desmoronan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El aguerrido Vegeta se enfrenta otra vez a Zarbon. Pero en esta ocasión, Vegeta ha aprendido a mantener la guardia frente a Zarbon y le obliga a transformarse ante los atónitos ojos de Bulma y Krilín
programme.sub-title: ¡Vuelvo a ser el de siempre! Goku se enfrenta a una gravedad de 100

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freezer intuye la derrota del guerrero Zarbon y monta en cólera. En otra parte de Namek, Vegeta se da cuenta de que le han robado una bola de dragón. ¡Y sospecha del pequeño Son Gohan porque se ha encontrado con él hace poco!
programme.sub-title: ¡El arma secreta de Freeza! Las diabólicas Fuerzas Especiales Ginyu

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku se dirige hacia el planeta Namek en la nave que el padre de Bulma ha construido para él. Mientras, Bulma se encarga de la bola de dragón que Son Gohan le ha robado a Vegeta, y las desgracias empiezan a sucederse una detrás de otra.
programme.sub-title: ¡Bulma está en peligro! La bola de cuatro estrellas cae en las manos de Freeza.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Bulma sigue en las manos de sus captores y tiene que utilizar todo su ingenio para librarse de ellos.
programme.sub-title: ¡Colisión frontal! El Kame Hame Ha y el Kaioh Ken

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Aunque está muerta de miedo, Bulma ha conseguido escapar. ¡Y tiene la bola de dragón! Han pasado cuatro días desde que Krilín y Son Gohan abandonaron el refugio; deciden utilizar su poder y avanzar rápido a sabiendas del riesgo que corren.
programme.sub-title: ¡La batalla definitiva se aproxima! ¡Llegan las Fuerzas Especiales Ginyu!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Las temidas Fuerzas Especiales de Freezer acaban de llegar. Los pobres Krilín, Son Gohan y Bulma tienen que contar... ¡cinco enemigos más! Y Goku aún no ha llegado.
programme.sub-title: ¡Gokū se aproxima a toda velocidad! Hay que escapar de las redes de Freeza

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Lo imposible se convierte en realidad cuando Krilín y Son Gohan se ven forzados a colaborar con su mayor enemigo, Vegeta, para tener una oportunidad contra las Fuerzas Especiales
programme.sub-title: ¡¿Truco o súper-magia?! ¡El Sr. Gourd se enfurece!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los cinco guerreros de las Fuerzas Especiales superan a Vegeta, Krilín y Son Gohan de largo, pero eso no impide que Vegeta luche. Los poderes de las Fuerzas Especiales asombran a nuestros protagonistas.
programme.sub-title: El salvaje Recoom. Es malo, brutal y extravagante

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los guerreros de las Fuerzas Especiales han perdido a uno de sus miembros. Gracias a un ataque combinado, Son Gohan y Krilín han vencido al que dominaba el tiempo. Vegeta hace gala de su poder y se enfrenta a un luchador que parece indestructible
programme.sub-title: ¡No mueras, Gohan! Gokū llega finalmente al campo de batalla

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El capitán de las fuerzas especiales le lleva las siete bolas de dragón a Freezer, pero el tirano se enoja porque no sabe como activarlas
programme.sub-title: ¡Una fuerza fuera de lo normal! Gokū, el Super Saiyajin de la leyenda

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist zurück ins Jahr 1955 und landet im Körper des Sheriffs von Potterville in Louisiana. Clayton Fullers Frau Laura ist in einer Nervenheilanstalt, nachdem sie als einzige ein Familienmassaker überlebt hat, das ihre Mutter angerichtet hat.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam springt erneut ins Jahr 1966, um Abigail Fuller zu retten. Vor elf Jahren musste er sich schon mal vor der Rache von Leta Aiders bewahren. Die glaubt bis heute, dass Abigail ihren Mann und ihre Tochter umgebracht hat.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Abigail wird erneut beschuldigt, einen Mord begangen zu haben, dieses Mal an Leta Aider. Die Tote war seit Jahren davon überzeugt, dass Abigail bereits ihren Mann und ihre Tochter umgebracht hat. Dies scheint sich nun zu bestätigen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam landet nach einem weiteren Zeitsprung in seiner Heimatstadt. Es ist der 22.12.1971. Er befindet sich im Körper des Farmers Bill Walters, der mit seiner Familie gerade im Begriff ist, eine Bank zu überfallen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist in das Jahr 1958 und schlüpft in den Körper des Bigamisten Marty Ellroy. Der ist mit zwei Frauen gleichzeitig verheiratet. Zudem hat Ellroy Spielschulden bei zwei zwielichtigen Gestalten namens Gus und Vic.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam wird als Hausfrau Margret Sanders im Jahr 1968 zusammen mit ihrer Tochter Suzi festgenommen. Dank der Beziehungen ihres Mannes George kommen sie allerdings schnell wieder frei und können an einer Kundgebung im Zuge der Frauenbewegung teilnehmen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist ins Jahr 1985 und findet sich im Körper der Radiomoderatorin Dr. Ruth Westheimer wieder. Die gibt ihren Zuhörern Tipps rund um das Thema Liebe. Sam alias Ruth soll Doug und Debbie, zwei Mitarbeiter, miteinander verkuppeln.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam landet am 10. März 1975 im Körper des exzentrischen Künstlers und Vampirs Nigel Covington. Sam soll das Leben von Alexandria, Nigels Frau, retten, die in der Nacht des "Blutmondes" ursprünglich umgebracht wurde.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam landet im Jahr 1956 und nimmt die Gestalt von "Erstsemester" Arnold an. Dieser ist stets darum bemüht, Unschuldige vor Bösem zu bewahren. Sams Aufgabe besteht zum Teil darin, die Studenten zu mehr Umsicht mit sich selbst zu bewegen.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Liz Tate wird vorgeworfen, dass sie ihre Zellennachbarin Carol Benning ermordet hat. Liz ist jedoch unschuldig. Der wahre Täter ist ein Gefängnisaufseher und heißt Meyers. Er hatte eine Affäre mit Carol. Nun will er die Schuld auf Liz schieben.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Dieses Mal reist Sam in das Jahr 1862, um das Schicksal seiner eigenen Familie zu ändern. Im Körper seines Urgroßvaters Captain John Beckett soll er das Herz von Olivia erobern. Die hat ihn ursprünglich fesseln lassen, weil er ein Nordstaatler ist.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam reist in das Jahr 1954 und schlüpft in den Körper des noch unbekannten Elvis Presley. Er soll der talentierten Musikerin Sue Allen Winters die Türen ins Showbusiness öffnen, da sie unter extremem Lampenfieber leidet.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Sam befindet sich im Jahr 1956. Außer ihm kann niemand Albert sehen, der ihn auch ständig begleitet. Albert klärt Sam über seine Mission auf, die er erfüllen muss, um wieder in sein angestammtes Leben in der Zukunft zurückreisen zu können.

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit

programme.title: Zurück in die Vergangenheit
